modulation by symbiont of host G-protein coupled receptor protein signal transduction
perturbation of host G protein-coupled receptor signal transduction pathway
narrow: modulation by symbiont of host signal transduction mediated by G-protein alpha subunit

modulation by symbiont of host signal transduction mediated by G-protein gamma subunit

definition: A process by which a symbiont alters or subverts the normal execution of a host G protein-coupled receptor signal transduction pathway. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host G protein-coupled receptor signal transduction pathway
